Post Date: 2020-06-09T23:41:33Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: [QUESTION] LiteDb v5 Query Api Group By Issue
Description: Hi!
I am trying to execute a LiteDB (v5) query but facing the problem with Group By.

I am building my expression in C# like that:
var r1 = collection.Query()
		        .GroupBy("Age")
		        .Select("{Key: @Key,Max: Max(Id)}").
		        ToArray();
Here I want to get the maximum Id of the person in each age group.

It results in the following SQL:

SELECT {Key:@Key,Max:MAX($.Id)}
FROM Person
GROUP BY $.Age

However, the engine throws this exception:

'Field 'Id' is invalid in the select list because it is not contained in either an aggregate function or the GROUP BY clause.'

Could you please explain how to use aggregate functions with Group By?

I was able to use only Count(*) or Max(@Key).

PS. I thought I might need to use 'Include' function to add the Id field into the groups, but GROUP BY doesn't allow me to do it.
